{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Enterprise Wilson Storage Link''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.hydrocarbonprocessing.com/news/2012/05/enterprise-starts-up-gas-processing-plant-in-texas-for-eagle-ford-shale/|title=hydrocarbonprocessing.com|website=hydrocarbonprocessing.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Yoakum gas processing plant, Texas to Wilson gas storage facility, Wharton County, Texas.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.hydrocarbonprocessing.com/news/2012/05/enterprise-starts-up-gas-processing-plant-in-texas-for-eagle-ford-shale/|title=hydrocarbonprocessing.com|website=hydrocarbonprocessing.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/refining-processing/gas-processing/article/17208234/enterprise-products-to-expand-eagle-ford-gas-pipeline-system|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Enterprise Products Partners LP<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.hydrocarbonprocessing.com/news/2012/05/enterprise-starts-up-gas-processing-plant-in-texas-for-eagle-ford-shale/|title=hydrocarbonprocessing.com|website=hydrocarbonprocessing.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''65 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.hydrocarbonprocessing.com/news/2012/05/enterprise-starts-up-gas-processing-plant-in-texas-for-eagle-ford-shale/|title=hydrocarbonprocessing.com|website=hydrocarbonprocessing.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''36 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.hydrocarbonprocessing.com/news/2012/05/enterprise-starts-up-gas-processing-plant-in-texas-for-eagle-ford-shale/|title=hydrocarbonprocessing.com|website=hydrocarbonprocessing.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.hydrocarbonprocessing.com/news/2012/05/enterprise-starts-up-gas-processing-plant-in-texas-for-eagle-ford-shale/|title=hydrocarbonprocessing.com|website=hydrocarbonprocessing.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Proposal year: '''2010<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/refining-processing/gas-processing/article/17208234/enterprise-products-to-expand-eagle-ford-gas-pipeline-system|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
